Constant reserve of 600 tokens set aside for treasure-key based minting.
Price in wei for a single token, settable by owner and checked against msg.value.
Maximum number of tokens mintable in one transaction, enforced in public mint.
Boolean flag gating the public multi-token mint function.
Boolean flag gating the team multi-token mint function.
Incrementing random seed nonce consumed by randomIndex to derive token ids.
Shuffle/permutation array mapping random slots to remaining available token indices.
Allowlist mapping controlling which addresses may mint during team sale.
Address of the ISpacePunksTreasureKeys contract used for key burning.
Owner-only setter that assigns the treasure keys contract address.
Non-reentrant function that checks key balance, burns an external key and mints a token to msg.sender.
Owner-only setter for the token price.
Owner-only function that toggles the inherited pause state.
Owner-only function enabling public sale and resetting max tokens per tx.
Owner-only function disabling public sale and setting max tokens per tx to 1.
Owner-only function flipping the team sale flag.
Pseudo-random index generator using nonce, msg.sender, block.difficulty and block.timestamp.
Internal helper that picks a random id and safely mints it to the recipient.
Payable public multi-mint gated by sale flag, supply caps, price and max-per-tx.
Payable team multi-mint gated by teamSale, allowlist and supply checks.
Deploys with PaymentSplitter/ERC721 initialization, sets price and team allowlist.
Caller-controlled address used as mint recipient, key owner and randomness input.
Miner-influenced timestamp feeding the pseudo-random id derivation in randomIndex.
External call to ISpacePunksTreasureKeys.burnKeyForAddress on a caller-supplied key type.
_safeMint invokes onERC721Received on the recipient, enabling an external callback.
SafeMath/add and mul arithmetic on totalSupply, amount and token price.
keccak256 randomness seeded with block.timestamp and block.difficulty, predictable by miners/callers.
Caller supplied mint quantity in mintPublicMultipleTokens and mintTeamMultipleTokens.
Recipient address parameter of _mintWithRandomTokenId.
Local ISpacePunksTreasureKeys instance wrapped around _treasureKeys in mintWithTreasureKey.
Local size of remaining mintable supply in randomIndex.
Local randomly derived index into the indices permutation array.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as key owner, burn target and mint recipient in mintWithTreasureKey.
Caller-controlled msg.sender is passed directly into the external burnKeyForAddress call.
mintWithTreasureKey performs the external burnKeyForAddress call before minting.
The external key burn precedes the internal _mintWithRandomTokenId state-changing mint.
_mintWithRandomTokenId calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on the receiver.
block.timestamp is hashed into the random index, making randomness timestamp dependent.
msg.sender is hashed into the random index, allowing caller influence over randomness.
nonce seed is incorporated into the random index computation.
randomIndex result is used as the token id to mint in _mintWithRandomTokenId.
_treasureKeys address is read and cast into the keys interface in mintWithTreasureKey.
setTreasureKeys writes the _treasureKeys state variable.
publicSale flag gates mintPublicMultipleTokens.
_maxTokensAtOnce is used to bound _amount in the public mint.
_tokenPrice is multiplied by amount and compared with msg.value.
teamSale flag gates mintTeamMultipleTokens.
_teamSaleAddresses allowlist check restricts team minting callers.
msg.sender is used as the mint recipient inside the public mint loop.
msg.sender is used as the mint recipient and allowlist key in the team mint.
Public mint loop calls _mintWithRandomTokenId which reaches the _safeMint callback.
Team mint loop calls _mintWithRandomTokenId which reaches the _safeMint callback.
mintPublicMultipleTokens performs getTokenPrice().mul(_amount) and totalSupply().add(_amount).
randomIndex computes TOKEN_LIMIT - totalSupply(), totalSize - 1 and value.add(1).
mintTeamMultipleTokens performs totalSupply().add(_amount) arithmetic.
randomIndex derives its result from a timestamp/difficulty based keccak seed.
block.timestamp flows into the predictable pseudo-random seed.
setTokenPrice writes the _tokenPrice state variable.
enablePublicSale sets publicSale to true.
disablePublicSale sets publicSale to false.
toggleTeamSale negates the teamSale state variable.
togglePaused manipulates the inherited pause state that bounds team sale behavior.

normalization_plan.reason: _amount is a caller parameter of mintPublicMultipleTokens used in its supply and price checks and mint loop.
_to is the recipient parameter of the internal _mintWithRandomTokenId helper.
keys local variable is the interface wrapper created inside mintWithTreasureKey.
totalSize local variable is computed and consumed inside randomIndex.
index local variable is the randomly derived slot used inside randomIndex.
value local variable is the returned mapped token id derived inside randomIndex.
